subject: cult-info-f
title: CULT.INFO.F.----PR.TRS.
description: Chart on book p. 340 (R(AS)CM(I)-24). CULT-INFO-F (culture information focus) is the subject; PR-TRS is the partner. From the subject: PROG-CONT (progressional continuance). From PR-TRS: ALT-DEF (alternative definitions). From PROG-CONT: PR-TRS, RT-ALGN (reality alignment), RE-ST (restructuralism), with the (P) prefix, "point of idea completion", and POL-DY (political dynamics). From ALT-DEF: TR (transformation). From RE-ST: APP-RDEF (applied redefinitions). From POL-DY: PART (participation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From TR: STF (source transfer).
